claim: VVERH DIGITAL publicly defines AI-assisted development as a methodology where part of software development is delegated to AI agents.
VVERH DIGITAL names Codex, Copilot and Cursor as examples of tools used in AI-assisted development.
VVERH DIGITAL develops corporate websites and digital products using a web stack that includes Node.js, Nuxt and TypeScript.
Surf states that one third of its code is generated by AI agents.
Surf states that the share of AI-generated code can reach 80% in some AI-agent scenarios.
Surf describes AI use across analytics, development, testing and code review.
AGIMA operates an internal LLM gateway used by developers and other employees.
AGIMA reports almost one million LLM requests per month from about one hundred of the most active employees.
AGIMA operates SiteOS, an AI-assisted system for website content and page workflows.
Пиксель Плюс offers support and development for projects created with Cursor, Claude Code and other AI tools.
Пиксель Плюс explicitly mentions Lovable, Bolt and Replit among AI platforms used to create projects it can support.
KTS says its developers tested Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Yandex Code Assistant, Codeium and GigaChat.
KTS reports that about half of its team uses AI assistants for code generation, tests and architecture diagrams.
red_mad_robot describes a multi-agent system that can generate patches for source code.
The documented red_mad_robot multi-agent system uses Qwen3-Coder for code generation.
SimbirSoft states that developers use Cursor Composer, Windsurf and Claude to generate code and automate routine tasks.
Evrone uses Spec-Driven Development on projects where AI agents participate in real product development.
Vibescript says AI is used for writing and checking code while people retain architecture and quality control.
Vibescript publicly lists Claude, OpenAI, Claude Code and Cursor among its AI tools.
L7 agency publicly describes its method as vibe coding using Claude Code, Cursor and GPT.
L7 agency describes a workflow based on one strong engineer plus AI with senior review.
